description: 车对e兵 — 车将军腾挪，等王协作

intro.popup_en: The white king is far away, but the rook can gain time with checks. First drive the black king away and take control of the pawn's promotion square.
intro.popup:
💡 白王远离，但车可以将军转移！
策略：车先将军逼走黑王，抢占兵升变路。

outro.popup_en: Key principle: use rook checks to reach the pawn's promotion route, then wait for the white king to join the fight.
outro.popup: ✅ 核心原则：车利用将军腾挪占据兵的升变路，等待白王进入战场协同作战。
